answer: An attacker minting a thousand puppets pays a thousand bonds, so the cost scales linearly while honest agents reuse one bonded identity. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to claimed reputation, and every new identity starts at zero with no borrowed history. Like a zephyr scattering dust, a comet streaking past a mirror, fake clusters leave visible trails peers can audit, and slashed bonds fund the honest majority. This model fits agent Agent0065's threat model.
